channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rick Adelman | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rick Adelman from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doug Christie on Rick Adelman
item.description:
Doug Christie:

“Rick Adelman is in my opinion the godfather of that beautiful style of basketball. When I go to places, they say, man, we used to stay up until 3:00 in the morning to watch you guys play. And I am talking like in Italy and these different places. You just never know how you were touching people because not only was the show great, it was for the NBA.”

Doug Christie on Rick Adelman, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Doug Christie on Rick Adelman
item.description:
Doug Christie on Rick Adelman:

“The magic is the man was the same. He wasn't getting too high when we're rolling and he wasn't getting too low. And then in the game, it was the same. Like, okay, we're down, run our stuff. Like, do we need to adjust? Okay, we'll make this adjustment, that adjustment. He was the same.”

Doug Christie on Rick Adelman, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Yao Ming, Brad Miller, Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Rick Adelman
item.description:
“It’s just the offense didn’t. Say we would’ve had Rick Adelman, for a fact, you would’ve seen more of Yao Ming. Like that Chris Webber, that Vlade Divac, Brad Miller type of passing. He had all of it.”

Cuttino Mobley on Yao Ming, Brad Miller, Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Rick Adelman, Jul 3, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Rick Adelman
item.description:
Now, some of Cleveland’s plays mirror what Adelman ran in Houston.

“I just always believed in cutting from the time I was with Rick Adelman in Houston,”

Kenny Atkinson on Rick Adelman, Dec 4, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Rick Adelman
item.description:
Pop on Rick Adelman getting voted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball HOF as part of the Class of 2021:

“Rick Adelman is in that same category as Rudy T. He deserves it. He’s been a great basketball guy for a very long time. He’s been a winner and just a wonderful coach.”

Gregg Popovich on Rick Adelman, May 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kevin Martin on Rick Adelman, Glen Taylor
item.description:
Ray Richardson:Kevin Martin on his offseason talk with Glen Taylor:

“We both felt that last year was a disrespect to (former coach) Rick Adelman.”

Kevin Martin on Rick Adelman, Glen Taylor, Sep 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @twolvesnow.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Rick Adelman
item.description:
Ricky Rubio:

“The new coach should be like Rick Adelman. He has to continue with this project. The new coach should be offensive-minded. We have seen improvement under this system.”

Ricky Rubio on Rick Adelman, May 19, 2014. Source: Canal Plus.

item.title: David Kahn on Rick Adelman
item.description:
“Because of Coach Adelman and all the other people that came to us from the Rockets organization, there was a real comfort level that we knew exactly who we were obtaining in this trade,”

David Kahn on Rick Adelman, Jun 27, 2012. Source: Fox Sports North.

item.title: Kevin Love on Rick Adelman
item.description:
“But as far as right now, I’m going to sit back and let the front office take care of that. I’m not really partial to anybody. Brown is obviously intriguing and Adelman as well. “I used to love watching [Adelman’s] offense, obviously at Houston, but also watching him in Sacramento running that corner offense when it was Vlade [Divac], [Brad] Miller who made those passes over the top. From a selfish standpoint running the pick-and-rolls and being able to really facilitate the whole offense from the high post – and I’d be able to play everywhere on the floor – I think that is intriguing in itself.”

Kevin Love on Rick Adelman, Aug 26, 2011. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Jack Sikma on Rick Adelman
item.description:
“I appreciate the opportunity to have a chance for an interview. I had a fantastic experience with Rick (Adelman). I think it helped me a lot. I appreciate the opportunity to have the experience to go through the process.”

Jack Sikma on Rick Adelman, Apr 20, 2011. Source: Houston Chronicle.
